summary: HF Sinclair Corporation filed an 8-K on August 26, 2026, announcing that its Board authorized a new $1.5 billion share repurchase program, effective immediately. The program replaces prior authorizations, with approximately $11 million remaining under the May 2024 program. Repurchases may occur in the open market or through privately negotiated transactions, including from REH Advisors Inc., subject to limitations. The program is discretionary and may be discontinued. The Board also authorized repurchases to offset compensation-related share issuances. The filing is a routine capital return event, not a Tender Offer, as shares will be bought in the market or privately. No specific price per share, premium, or adviser was named. Watch for repurchase execution pace.
